blocks.prompt: 11 Hamza wants to distribute 15 pencils among 6 needy children in this way that the youngest gets 4 pencils and others get 2 pencils. Find how many ways, there are of arranging in a row form?
blocks.explanation:
Pehle sawal ko ghaur se parhiye: pencils ka zikr sirf yeh batata hai ke sab se chhota bacha (youngest) khaas hai, kyunke usay 4 pencils milti hain aur baqi sab ko 2. Asal sawal yeh hai ke 6 bachon ko ek line mein kitne tareeqon se khara kar sakte hain.
Answer key ki tarah youngest ki jagah fix hai (maslan line mein sab se pehle), aur baqi 5 bache kisi bhi tarteeb mein khare ho sakte hain.
Plan: youngest ko fix karo, baqi 5 ko \(5!\) tareeqon se. (Pencils ki ginti theek nahi baithti; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.)
Rozmarra ki misaal: socho Hamza ek taqreeb mein bachon ko line mein khara karke pencils baant raha hai. Sab se chhote bache ko woh sab se aage khara karta hai taake usay pehle aur zyada pencils milen; baqi bache peeche kisi bhi tarteeb mein khare ho sakte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 bache; youngest ko 4 pencils aur woh fix jagah par (line mein pehla); baqi 5 bachon ko 2, 2 pencils.
Humein find karna hai: bachon ko line mein khara karne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Jo cheez fix ho us ka sirf 1 tareeqa; baqi cheezon ki poori tarteeb \({}^{n}P_{n} = n!\).
Kyun: Counting ke sawal mein pehle yeh pehchaanna zaroori hai ke kaun si maloomat asal ginti par asar karti hai aur kaun si sirf kahani ka hissa hai. Yahan pencils kahani hain; bachon ki tarteeb asal sawal hai.

Youngest ko jagah dein
\[\text{Tareeqe} = 1\]
Kyun: Youngest baqi bachon se alag (khaas) hai, is liye us ki jagah pehle se tay hai: line mein sab se aage. Jab jagah tay ho to us ke liye koi choice nahi bachti, yani sirf 1 tareeqa.

Baqi 5 bachon ki tarteeb
\[{}^{5}P_{5} = 5! = 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 120\]
Kyun: 5 alag bache aur 5 khaali jagahein. Pehli khaali jagah par 5 mein se koi bhi, phir 4, phir 3, 2, 1.
Dhyan dein: Baqi 5 bachon ko 2, 2 pencils milti hain, magar bache khud alag alag hain (har bache ka naam alag), is liye un ki jagah badalne se nayi tarteeb banti hai.

Kul tareeqe
\[1 \times 5! = 120\]
Kyun: Fundamental principle of counting: youngest ka 1 tareeqa aur baqi ke 120, dono multiply.
Dhyan dein: Pencils (4 aur 2) ko multiply karne ya un ke factorials lagane ki koi zaroorat nahi; pencils sirf yeh batati hain ke kaun khaas hai.

Tasdeeq
Agar youngest kahin bhi khara ho sakta to jawab \(6! = 720 = 6 \times 120\) hota: us ki 6 mumkin jagahein, aur har jagah ke saath baqi bachon ki \(5!\) tarteebein. Jagah fix karne se \(\frac{720}{6} = 120\) bachte hain \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Is se saaf pata chalta hai ke jagah fix karne ka ginti par kya asar hota hai: har ek fix cheez ginti ko us ki jagahon ki tadaad se chhota kar deti hai.
blocks.final_answer:
120 tareeqe (youngest fix jagah par)
Yaani youngest aage aur baqi 5 kisi bhi tarteeb mein: 120 tareeqe.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "15 pencils" chhapa hai, lekin youngest ko 4 aur baqi 5 bachon ko 2, 2 milti hain: \(4 + 5 \times 2 = 14\) pencils, 15 nahi. Pencils ki tadaad se tarteeb ki ginti par koi farq nahi parta. Answer key ka jawab 120 \(= 5!\) youngest ko fix jagah par rakh kar baqi paanch bachon ki tarteeb ginta hai; agar youngest ki jagah fix na ho to jawab \(6! = 720\) hoga.
